videoTitle: The One Thing Most L5/S1 Exercise Advice Gets Wrong
videoDescription: Not all movement helps an L5/S1 disc injury—and some can make it worse. The key isn't just "core work" or stretching; it's finding your directional preference and watching for centralization. Learn what physical therapy research actually says about extension exercises and recovery timelines at mindtivate.com
script: You've been told to strengthen your core for that L5/S1 injury. But physical therapists don't start there—they start by testing which direction your pain moves. It's called centralization, and if your leg pain shifts closer to your lower back during a movement...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
